summary: Frontend-only dark-theme final contrast pass verified via Playwright (computed styles + contrast ratios) on the public preview URL. All 3 requested fixes CONFIRMED: (1) .whatif-stats > div now bg rgb(17,24,39) with strong #f8fafc (16.96:1) and .highlight bg rgb(6,78,59) with strong 9.29:1; (2) all 3 [data-testid^='suggested-question-'] chips are bg rgb(17,24,39) / color rgb(226,232,240) = 14.39:1 inside the dark .chat-body (no white blocks); (3) .primary-btn computes to rgb(4,120,87) = #047857 on both /goals ('New goal') and /profile ('Save profile'), white text 5.48:1 (AA pass). Ran an automated DOM sweep on 11 authenticated routes for any remaining light-bg + light-text element: /analysis, /ask, /whatif, /settings, /profile are fully clean; remaining hits are decorative, text-less elements only (progress-bar tracks, timeline dots, pastel icon tiles). Regression flows all pass: login, theme-dark toggle + persistence, goal create + delete (data-testid edit/delete present), profile save (shows Saved), memory-aware chat (GPT-5.4 reply referencing stored profile), sign-out redirect to /login, demo banner. Zero console errors (only the pre-existing Emergent instrumentation <span> in <option> hydration warning on /whatif).

issues: Difference card value uses inline color #087f56 on #111827 = 3.53:1 — passes AA-large only, marginal. Suggest #34d399 / #6ee7b7 for the positive delta in dark mode.
.whatif-stats > div.highlight small/span text #94a3b8 on #064e3b = 3.79:1 — fails AA 4.5:1 for small text. Suggest #a7f3d0 for labels inside the highlight card.
.bar and .goal-progress track background stays light #edf3f0 in dark mode — reads as a bright strip on dark cards (cosmetic only, no text inside). Suggest #1e293b track.
.upload-icon keeps light mint tile #e7f9f0 with #10b981 glyph (~2.3:1 icon contrast) — light block in dark UI.
Sign-out icon button has no data-testid (had to fall back to header button nth(1)); notification bell/avatar also lack testids.

action_items: Lighten .whatif-stats .highlight small/span to ~#a7f3d0 (currently 3.79:1) and the positive delta inline color to a lighter mint in dark mode.
Optional polish: dark track for .bar/.goal-progress and dark variant for .upload-icon in dark theme.
Add data-testid to header sign-out / notification / avatar buttons.
